title: १०० वटा high-impact verb (१–५०)
blocks: Column-हरूलाई एउटा word family को रूपमा पढ्नुहोस्। यो table-को असली शक्ति past tense घोक्नुमा होइन; असली शक्ति भनेको एउटा row भरि एउटा रूपबाट अर्को रूपमा जान सक्नु हो। increase (verb) धेरै प्रयोग भइसकेको छ भने an increase (noun) वा increasing (adjective)-मा सर्नुहोस्, अनि वाक्यलाई नयाँ ढंगले बनाउनुहोस्। Lexical Resource-ले ठ्याक्कै यही flexibility-लाई अंक दिन्छ।
**noun**: यो family-को सबैभन्दा काम लाग्ने noun
**adjective**: यो family-को सबैभन्दा काम लाग्ने adjective
**preposition**: verb वा त्यसको noun-पछि सबैभन्दा धेरै आउने preposition
**-**: त्यो वर्गमा एक शब्दको चलनचल्तीको रूप छैन, वा कुनै निश्चित preposition छैन
हिज्जे British नियम अनुसार छ (analyse, emphasise, utilise) — IELTS ले यसलाई स्वीकार गर्छ, र यही अपेक्षा पनि गर्छ।

title: १०० वटा high-impact verb (५१–१००)
blocks: Verb affect-को noun effect हो, affect होइन। भाषामा सबैभन्दा धेरै परीक्षामा आउने हिज्जेको trap यही हो, त्यसैले row ५ दुई पटक पढ्नुहोस्: तपाईं कुनै कुरालाई affect गर्नुहुन्छ (verb), अनि त्यसको नतिजा effect हो (noun)।

धेरैजसो row-मा शब्दको वर्ग बदलेर paraphrase गर्न सकिन्छ। “The policy improved education” लाई “the policy led to an improvement in education” वा “the policy had a beneficial effect on education.” बनाउन सकिन्छ। Row भरि एउटा रूपबाट अर्कोमा सर्ने अभ्यास गर्नुहोस्, जबसम्म यो आफैँ नआओस्; अध्याय ५ मा paraphrase-को मुख्य इन्जिन यही हो।

title: Linking word upgrade गर्ने गाइड
blocks: Cohesion-लाई सिधै अंक दिइन्छ — Writing-मा Coherence and Cohesion criterion-मा, र Speaking-मा Fluency and Coherence भित्र। धेरैजसो candidate-ले विचारहरूलाई and, but, so, because र also ले मात्र जोड्छन्। यी गलत होइनन्, तर पूरै लेखाइ यिनैमा मात्र टेकेको छ भने त्यो Band 6 को संकेत हो। उपाय भनेको केही छानिएका उच्च स्तरका device हुन् — सही तरिकाले प्रयोग गरिएका, र एउटामाथि अर्को थुपारिएका होइनन्।
furthermore, moreover, in addition, additionally, what is more
Renewable energy is clean. Furthermore, it is becoming cheaper each year.
however, nevertheless, in contrast, conversely, on the contrary
The scheme was expensive. Nevertheless, it delivered clear benefits.
notwithstanding, despite this, even so, admittedly, granted that
Notwithstanding the cost, the investment proved worthwhile.
owing to, due to, on account of, as a result of, given that, since
Owing to a shortage of teachers, class sizes have grown.
consequently, therefore, thus, hence, as a result, accordingly
Demand fell sharply; consequently, prices dropped.
Some favour strict rules; conversely, others prefer flexibility.
for instance, to illustrate, namely, such as
Several cities, such as Dhaka and Chittagong, are expanding rapidly.
in conclusion, to sum up, overall, on balance, ultimately
On balance, the advantages outweigh the drawbacks.
“due to” र “owing to” पछि noun आउँछ, clause होइन।
Due to the government invested more, education improved.
Owing to greater investment, education improved. / Education improved because the government invested more.
यी device-हरूपछि noun वा noun phrase आउँछ। subject र verb भएको पूरा clause चाहिन्छ भने because प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
The plan was costly, however, it worked.
The plan was costly. However, it worked. / The plan was costly; however, it worked.
however ले दुई वटा पूरा वाक्य जोड्दा त्यसको अगाडि full stop वा semicolon र पछाडि comma आउँछ। दुवैतिर comma मात्र राख्दा comma splice बन्छ, र त्यसमा अंक काटिन्छ।

एउटा विचारका लागि एउटा cohesive device नै पुग्छ। लगातार ३ वटा वाक्य Moreover, Furthermore, In addition बाट सुरु गर्नु यान्त्रिक अति-प्रयोग हो, र examiner-हरूले यसमा स्पष्ट रूपमा अंक काट्छन्। Device-हरू फेरबदल गरेर प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, र केही वाक्यलाई अर्थबाट मात्रै जोडिन दिनुहोस्। Range भनेको विविधता हो, घनत्व होइन।

blocks.title: Exercise 3.1 · Verb-को रूप र Collocation Drill
blocks.instructions: हरेक वाक्यलाई bracket-मा दिइएको verb-को सही रूपले पूरा गर्नुहोस्; खाली ठाउँमा verb दिइएको छैन भने सही preposition राख्नुहोस्। रूप र preposition-का जोडी जाँच्न १०० वटा verb-को table प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Over the past decade, the urban population has ______ (grow) by nearly twenty per cent.
items.reason: present perfect-मा has + V3 चाहिन्छ; grow irregular हो (grew, grown)।

items.prompt: If food prices continue ______ (rise), many families will struggle.
items.reason: continue पछि infinitive र -ing रूप दुवै चल्छन्।

items.prompt: Rural households often depend ______ agriculture for their entire income.
items.reason: depend on निश्चित collocation हो।

items.prompt: Many students benefit ______ free online learning resources.
items.reason: benefit from।

items.prompt: Between 2000 and 2010, car sales ______ (peak) at forty thousand units.
items.reason: सकिएको समय-अवधिका लागि simple past।

items.prompt: Air pollution in the capital has ______ (rise) sharply since 2010.
items.reason: present perfect (has risen); rise intransitive हो, त्यसैले object आउँदैन।

items.prompt: Governments should invest more heavily ______ public transport.
items.reason: invest in।

items.prompt: Smallpox was completely ______ (eradicate) by the end of the 1970s.
items.reason: passive voice-मा was + V3 चाहिन्छ।

items.prompt: Automation may ______ (undermine) job security in several sectors.
items.reason: modal may पछि base form आउँछ।

items.prompt: The report ______ (focus) mainly on youth unemployment.
items.reason: present simple, third person singular (the report focuses on)।

items.prompt: By 2020, the jobless rate had ______ (fall) to a record low.
items.reason: past perfect-मा had + V3 चाहिन्छ; fall irregular हो (fell, fallen)।

items.prompt: Tourism contributes significantly ______ the local economy.
items.reason: contribute to।

items.prompt: Strict penalties can ______ (deter) people ______ committing crimes.
items.reason: can पछि base form; संरचना deter someone from doing हो।

items.prompt: The company has been ______ (invest) heavily in renewable technology.
items.reason: present perfect continuous-मा has been + V4 चाहिन्छ।

items.prompt: Chronic water shortages often result ______ poor long-term planning.
items.reason: result from ले कारण देखाउँछ; result in ले नतिजा देखाउँछ।

items.prompt: Renewable sources are gradually ______ (replace) fossil fuels.
items.reason: present continuous-मा are + V4 चाहिन्छ।

items.prompt: The new curriculum is ______ (design) to ______ (enhance) critical thinking.
items.reason: passive is designed; to पछि base form।

items.prompt: Coastal communities must ______ (adapt) ______ rising sea levels.
items.reason: must पछि base form; adapt to।

items.prompt: Over the last century, average temperatures have ______ (rise) steadily.
items.reason: present perfect (have risen)।

items.prompt: The charity has ______ (provide) thousands of families ______ clean water.
items.reason: present perfect has provided; provide someone with something।

blocks.title: Exercise 3.2 · Cohesive Device प्रयोग गरेर रूपान्तरण
blocks.instructions: तलको paragraph लगभग Band 6.0 स्तरको छ। यसका विचारहरू ठीक छन्, तर वाक्यहरू छोटा छन् र सामान्य connector-ले मात्र जोडिएका छन्। यसलाई Band 8.0 देखि 9.0 स्तरको एउटै जोडिएको paragraph-को रूपमा फेरि लेख्नुहोस् — उच्च स्तरका cohesive device सही तरिकाले र फेरबदल गरेर प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। नयाँ विचार नथप्नुहोस्; linking र प्रवाह मात्र सुधार्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Online education has become very popular. It is cheaper than traditional classes. Students can also study from home. But it has some problems. There is less interaction with teachers. Also, many students lack self-discipline. So, a lot of them do not finish their courses. Online education is useful. But it cannot fully replace the classroom.
items.answer: Online education has grown enormously in popularity, largely because it is cheaper than traditional classes and allows students to study from home. Notwithstanding these advantages, it carries certain drawbacks. To begin with, there is far less interaction with teachers. Moreover, many learners lack the self-discipline that independent study demands; consequently, a significant proportion fail to complete their courses. Online education is therefore undeniably useful, yet it cannot fully replace the classroom.
items.reason: because ले सही तरिकाले पूरा clause सुरु गरेको छ, भने Notwithstanding पछि सही तरिकाले noun phrase (these advantages) आएको छ, clause होइन; consequently अगाडिको semicolon ले दुई वटा सम्बन्धित clause जोडेको छ; कुनै device दोहोरिएको छैन, त्यसैले cohesion यान्त्रिक नभई विविध छ।
